how_to_find: Open your copy of the repo on GitHub and read the date of the newest commit. Match it to the list below. The code also holds a VERSION value near the top of src/index.ts, and the /health address on your Railway site shows it. The repo has no git tags that this wizard could confirm (VERIFY).

versions.title: Table tools (code version 2.4.0)
versions.summary: Commit b12aa13 on 2026-10-09 adds table tools. Version label 2.4.0 comes from the commit message and the VERSION value in src/index.ts. The date comes from commit dates. VERIFY the date against your own copy.

changes.text: Tool gdocs_read_tables reads every top-level table in a tab.
Tool gdocs_write_cells writes text into table cells.

upgrade_steps.title: Pull the change into your repo
upgrade_steps.text: In your copy of the repo on GitHub, choose Sync fork, then Update branch. Railway redeploys by itself. Then open the /health address and check the version.

versions.title: Formatting tools (code version 2.3.0)
versions.summary: Commit 74e0a22 on 2026-07-01 adds formatting tools. VERIFY the date against your own copy.

changes.text: Tool gdocs_format_text sets bold, italic, strikethrough and underline.
Tools gdocs_make_bullets and gdocs_remove_bullets change paragraphs into native lists and back.

upgrade_steps.title: Pull the change into your repo
upgrade_steps.text: In your copy of the repo on GitHub, choose Sync fork, then Update branch. Railway redeploys by itself.

versions.title: Any-doc targeting (code versions 2.1.0 and 2.2.0)
versions.summary: Commits from 2026-06-03 let each tool target any Google Doc by link or ID. The tab name became optional. VERIFY the date against your own copy.

changes.text: A doc argument on all tools. It accepts a Google Doc link or ID.
The tab name is optional when a doc has one tab.
An optional second shortcut named radhika, set by the GDOCS_RADHIKA_DOC_ID variable.

upgrade_steps.title: Pull the change into your repo
upgrade_steps.text: In your copy of the repo on GitHub, choose Sync fork, then Update branch. Railway redeploys by itself.

versions.title: Generic Google Docs server (code version 2.0)
versions.summary: Commits from 2026-05-29 turn the server into a generic Google Docs tool server and remove fixed tab names. The first code was added on 2026-05-28. VERIFY the dates against your own copy.

changes.text: Tab names are now fully dynamic.
The server runs TypeScript directly with tsx. There is no build step.
Tools to list tabs, read a tab, append text, insert text after a string, and find and replace.

upgrade_steps.title: Pull the change into your repo
upgrade_steps.text: In your copy of the repo on GitHub, choose Sync fork, then Update branch. Railway redeploys by itself.
